release: NEXT UPDATE. Not part of the current work. Do not implement until the user says so.
use: Circular archetype crest. Replaces the Ego mode icon while Ego is active (ignite only: it swaps in and glows; the Ego bar stays the timer). Also the 38 px emblem on the player panel.
dualBuild: While Ego is active, a dual build crossfades smoothly back and forth between its main and secondary archetype crests. Archetypes in the same family share one crest, so a same-family build shows one crest and does not crossfade.
layout: Disc fills the centre; the coloured glow is soft and transparent toward the edge. The disc is about 80% of the image width.

egoMode.release: NEXT UPDATE, together with the crests. Not part of the current work.
egoMode.change: Ego mode now boosts only the attributes in the player's own archetype categories.
egoMode.rule: Pure build (both archetypes from the same family): a flat +8 to its archetype categories. Dual build: +5 to the main archetype's categories and +3 to the secondary archetype's.
egoMode.toConfirmWithUser: Confirm the overlap reading (+5 and +3 add to +8), and that 'the limit' means the +8 max and that ratings also stay capped at 99.
egoMode.categories: An archetype's categories are BOTH its primary and its secondary attributes (user decision).
egoMode.overlap: If an attribute is in both archetypes of a dual build, the boosts add: +5 (main) + 3 (secondary) = +8, the same as the pure-build max. No attribute gets more than +8 from Ego, and Ego never takes a rating past 99. (Claude's reading of the user's 'adds up to the limit', sent to the user to confirm.)
